description: Group existing entities into a new named block definition, like BLOCK in a CAD program. The entities are moved into the block (rebased so basePoint becomes its origin). With insert true (default) one block reference is placed at basePoint where the entities were, so the drawing looks unchanged; with insert false only the definition is created. Works on LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, POINT, 3DFACE, TEXT, MTEXT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, ELLIPSE, SOLID, SPLINE and HATCH in one space (block references with attributes are refused); other types are refused by name. Returns the block handle and the INSERT handle.

basePoint.description: World point that becomes the block origin; default [0,0,0].

handles.description: Hex entity handles, all in the same space.

insert.description: Place one reference where the entities were. Default true.

name: cad.make_block
